patch_description: Instead of returning empty points, this approach treats Heilbronn placement as continuous maximin optimization: it starts from a deterministic low-discrepancy (golden-ratio) initialization inside the triangle, then runs a projected maximin local ascent. At each iteration it computes the smallest-area triangle, computes numerical gradients of that area w.r.t. each point (only the constraining triplet matters), moves all points to increase the minimal area, and projects points back into the triangle via barycentric coordinates. Multiple deterministic restarts (fixed seeds) are used and the best configuration is kept. This directly optimizes the primary metric and is fully deterministic, with a graceful fallback to the initialization if optimization fails.
